## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The router consumes only typed profile fields and its rule evaluation is...

The system SHALL ensure that the router consumes only typed profile fields and its rule evaluation is unchanged, asserted by routing tests that pass a hand-written profile.

#### Scenario: The router consumes only typed profile fields and its rule evaluation is...

WHEN `extract-the-task-routing-profile-as-typed-fields` is implemented
THEN The router consumes only typed profile fields and its rule evaluation is unchanged, asserted by routing tests that pass a hand-written profile.

### Requirement: The routing audit event carries the probabilities for every profile field it...

The system SHALL ensure that the routing audit event carries the probabilities for every profile field it was given.

#### Scenario: The routing audit event carries the probabilities for every profile field it...

WHEN `extract-the-task-routing-profile-as-typed-fields` is implemented
THEN The routing audit event carries the probabilities for every profile field it was given.

### Requirement: With the helper returning None the router still resolves using its declared...

The system SHALL ensure that with the helper returning None the router still resolves using its declared or default profile, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: With the helper returning None the router still resolves using its declared...

WHEN `extract-the-task-routing-profile-as-typed-fields` is implemented
THEN With the helper returning None the router still resolves using its declared or default profile, covered by a test.

### Requirement: A fixture set of task descriptions yields the expected profile fields, with...

The system SHALL ensure that a fixture set of task descriptions yields the expected profile fields, with duration and scope agreement recorded.

#### Scenario: A fixture set of task descriptions yields the expected profile fields, with...

WHEN `extract-the-task-routing-profile-as-typed-fields` is implemented
THEN A fixture set of task descriptions yields the expected profile fields, with duration and scope agreement recorded.
